instructions.objective: Launch Bridge2Babble on this real iPhone. Allow microphone and speech-recognition permissions if prompted. Verify English is selected as the source language and Spanish as the destination language. Enter the synthetic phrase 'Do you have any allergies to medication?' in the typed input and tap Translate. Report whether the conversation shows the original phrase plus a Spanish translation, or whether the app reports a model or language-readiness error. Do not enter or retain any real patient data.
